hadithCalendar: Use case: style-transfer. Create a new illustration for the 'Hadith & Islamic Calendar' onboarding page of Manarat Al-Muslim. The three attached images are style references from the app, not edit targets. Match their flat, friendly 2D editorial cartoon style, simple shapes, very limited cel shading, thin restrained detail lines, and warm colors. Make ONE connected composition: an open cream-paged Hadith book with a deep muted teal cover in the foreground, and a small freestanding calendar behind it with a coral header, a simple blank grid, one gold highlighted date square, and a small gold crescent emblem. A few small white diamond sparkles tie it together. No Quran verse or Arabic writing; no letters, numerals or text anywhere. The book's pages contain only a few decorative neutral horizontal marks and a subtle gold border, not generated religious text. Palette: deep muted teal #355A64, soft coral #ED8067, warm gold #DDA552, cream #FFF2D4, pale blue-green #D7E7E7. This should feel drawn by the same illustrator as the supplied Quran/book and Tasbeeh/hand graphics. Do not copy the old four-tile Hadith collage; one open book plus one calendar only. Composition: square canvas, entire connected scene fits inside the central 76% of the canvas. Use an exactly circular pale blue-green backplate centered in the canvas, diameter 84% of canvas; leave outside that circle genuinely transparent. Keep every object and decoration at least 4% of canvas inside the circle's edge so nothing is clipped. Real transparent PNG alpha outside the circle, no painted checkerboard, no black or white rectangular backdrop. Avoid photographic detail, 3D, gradients, gloss, heavy outlines, shadows outside the circle, watermark, logos. Intended to render clearly as a 250px onboarding illustration in both light and dark UI.
charity: Use case: style-transfer. Create an onboarding illustration for 'A Charity for All' in the same friendly flat 2D editorial cartoon style as the supplied Manarat Al-Muslim illustrations. The images are STYLE REFERENCES only; do not modify them. Subject: a close-up of two warm peach-colored open hands with modest cream cuffs gently cupping a small mound of earth, with a healthy little plant growing from it: a slender stem and three broad deep-teal/sage leaves. A small warm-gold heart floats above the growing plant, expressing Sadaqah Jariyah: kindness whose good continues to grow. A few tiny white diamond sparkles around the scene. The hand style must closely match the supplied Tasbeeh illustration: simplified clear fingers and warm minimal flat shading, without realism. One unified composition, not multiple tiles or an infographic. Match the app palette: muted teal #355A64, sage green, subtle coral cuff detail #ED8067, peach skin, cream, warm gold #DDA552, and an exactly circular pale blue-green #D7E7E7 backplate. Square canvas. Center that backplate and give it a diameter of 94% of the canvas, with a completely transparent exterior. Keep all hands, leaves, heart, and accents wholly inside the central 80% of the canvas, with no forms crossing the circle. True transparent PNG alpha outside the circle, never paint a checkerboard. No words, lettering, currency, numbers, logos or watermark. Avoid glossy 3D, photographic textures, complex shading, gradients, heavy outlines, dramatic lighting and hard shadows. The original dedication is handled by the app text, so this artwork must contain no writing. It must look like a companion to the existing Quran and Tasbeeh pictures at a 250px display size on light and dark app backgrounds.
